title: Excessive battery usage with time / data growth
symptom: After two years, the phone battery lasts only about 10 hours, with AAPS accounting for more than 20% of battery usage. Purging AAPS data (about 1GB) restored battery life to 24 hours. Other users report similar issues even after resetting databases.
cause: The thread suggests that data growth over time causes excessive battery usage, but no definitive root cause is established. One user speculates there is a data access pattern that doesn't scale.
fix: Purging AAPS data and importing settings back helped the original reporter. A maintainer notes that cleanup is available in 3.2 beta. However, other users report that resetting databases only marginally helped.
evidence_quote: After reading a post, that purging the AAPS data, could help with battery usage, I gave it a go. My AAPS user data storage use was reported at about 1GB. Purged it, imported back the settings and indeed, the AAPS is not first in the list anymore and phone battery now easily handles 24hrs again!
